steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: Parfait Medici—that's the name of mine that resonates across both banks of the Rust, the name of DisCity's stock market guru. This Parfait is a frequent face in finance magazine interviews, the star of upper-class investment salons, a legend of investment and value, and the most intriguing and mysterious tycoon.
[Television]

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: This stock was once just an unassuming second-tier blue chip, but now, like the unprecedented technological innovations exhibited at the Great Expo, it's rewriting the rules of the capital market right before our eyes.

steps.speaker: Host
steps.content: What a brilliant analogy! But when we look at Eastside Aster Industrial's 46-point surge in just three months, some analysts are calling it pure speculation—hot money chasing momentum. How do you respond to that?

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: Oh dear, when champagne overflows, fools see only the fizz, while the wise taste the decades in every drop.

steps.speaker: Host
steps.content: Look at that! Parfait's words just sent shockwaves through the market. Aster Industrial's stock is up another 2 points! I've said it before, and I'll say it again: Never question the vision of the stock market guru Parfait!

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: Parfait—that's my original name, a con... credit transaction specialist from the West District slums. The closest I ever got to high society was working at an Eastside concert hall, which was perhaps also the closest I'd ever been to wealth.

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: These two identities should be worlds apart, especially in DisCity. And yet, here I stand between them. Not by grinding day and night, not by some miraculous windfall... but simply due to the easiest thing of all—

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: I got a superpower. Just as city-states leverage credit to mint currency, I turn credit into tangible wealth. When people believe the stock market guru can work miracles? The stock market guru indeed conjures real money out of thin air.

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: And I happen to be a natural in gaining trust.

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: Since then, I've been swimming in the investment market like a fish in water. It's a battlefield of information, expectations, and above all, credit. And once I have credit? Information and expectations become my allies.

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: In return, I only need to pay a modest "membership fee" to the organization that grants me power, and occasionally handle some very minor tasks.

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: And there's one more thing to be wary of. The source of this power is everyone's "trust" in the stock market guru. My money flows into the hands of those who believe in me, and if that faith ever starts to waver, everything will vanish like smoke.

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: So, I must be cautious. I have to live up to people's impression of being "wealthy," ensure my financial activities aren't questioned (they've been completely legitimized now, in fact), and also—

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: I can't let anyone discover that I have this superpower, and I can't let anyone find out that beneath the legendary stock market guru "Parfait Medici" is just little broke "Parfait," a nobody.
[Enter Flashback 1]

steps.speaker: Nirvana Representative
steps.content: Mmm... the cover photo does capture essence rather well. As one would expect from the renowned stock market guru. An excellent stylist choice. Is this another gem from your exclusive little black book of contacts? Any chance you could make an introduction?

steps.speaker: Nirvana Representative
steps.content: ...That vacant expression isn't helping anyone. No matter how boring this expo is, we have contracts to sign here. The Fraser representatives are waiting at the negotiation table, and those overseas assets won't manage themselves. Can't you at least pretend to care for their sake?
Investments thrive on prudence, and true wealth demands respect before acquisition. Wouldn't you agree, my friend?

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: I just happened to catch Thalia's stream, absolutely not because I enjoy her budget recommendations. As long as I don't indulge again, no harm done. Everything's perfectly under control.
[Enter Flashback 2] Passing through the VIP hallway

steps.speaker: Nirvana Representative
steps.content: Wait, what?? Who let this outsider jump into the fight?!

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: Patience, my friend. Didn't we agree that everything would be settled at my dinner party?

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: Let's look forward to the feast that awaits us that evening.

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: It's fine. So what if the MBCC Chief is here? That doesn't mean he's hunting Sinners. And even if he is, that doesn't mean I'm his target. Yeah, everything's fine.
steps.female_content: It's fine. So what if the MBCC Chief is here? That doesn't mean she's hunting Sinners. And even if she is, that doesn't mean I'm her target. Yeah, everything's fine.

steps.content: [Flashback 3]

steps.speaker: Fraser Ambassador
steps.content: Next up, we have a special performance for you—an improvised dance piece inspired by Lamentur.

steps.speaker: Fraser Ambassador
steps.content: Presenting the nomadic blade dancer—<color=#fb9259>Jasmine</color>.

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: The MBCC Chief is right beside me, but he's totally lost in the performance. As long as he doesn't notice me, he won't suspect me. Everything's fine...
steps.female_content: The MBCC Chief is right beside me, but she's totally lost in the performance. As long as she doesn't notice me, she won't suspect me. Everything's fine...

steps.content: [Flashback 4]

steps.speaker: Nirvana Representative
steps.content: Which city-state is she from? This isn't how business works here! Let us speak with her! It's not every day that my friend here finds something that she likes. We can't just let that—

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: ...Please stop it, my friend. If you value our friendship, stop drawing his attention already...
steps.female_content: ...Please stop it, my friend. If you value our friendship, stop drawing her attention already...

steps.content: [Flashback 5] Syndicate Slums

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: When I left home that morning, I never imagined the day would turn so... eventful. But it's not over yet. As the night falls, I find my Eastside mansion swarmed with a crowd, all clamoring for wisdom from the "stock market guru." But I desperately need rest.

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: Then, it hits me... Near the Great Expo, there's still one place where I can find peace—my old home, the cradle of my soul. No reporters hounding me, no clients queuing for advice, just the quiet hum of the night. A stolen moment of tranquility.

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: With renewed determination, I carefully disguise myself, move with caution, and avoid any potential threats. Finally, the last step! Open the window, slip inside, and I'll reach my longed-for sanctuary—just one peaceful, quiet night is all I need—
[Big CG]

Their screams pierce the air in unison—then, as if bound by invisible strings, both women clamp their hands over their mouths. The sudden silence leaves only the television's chatter echoing through the room.
[Back to TV]

steps.speaker: Host
steps.content: As we wrap up the program, what advice would you offer to everyday investors?

On the television screen, Parfait plucks a pen from the table, uncaps it with a decisive click, and turns over her interview notes. In swift, sure strokes, she sketches deep blue lines across the blank page, then scatters musical notes above them—the simple notation of a tune.

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: Think of the melody of "La Vie en Rose"—you need the waltz's brisk grace, yes, but never forget the power of a well-timed pause.
Amid thunderous applause, the interview program comes to an end. Parfait waves goodbye to the audience and caps her pen.
...Clack.
That is the sound of the red clown nose falling to the floor from Parfait, who now stands rigid as a fence post in the center of the room, utterly still.

The round red nose rolls across the floor, wobbling to a stop at Sibilla's feet in the doorway. She bends to retrieve it, eyes flicking between the DisFortune Weekly cover on the wall and the woman who has just climbed through the window.

steps.speaker: Sibilla
steps.content: ...Parfait... Medici?

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: You got the wrong person.
She denies it immediately.

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: My full name is Par Florence Isabeau Celestine Montmorency Fait. I have nothing to do with Parfait. Who is Parfait Medici anyway? I don't know her.

steps.speaker: Sibilla
steps.content: You live here? DisCity's stock market guru lives here?

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: No. Tonight is the White-Bearded Elder's Gift-Giving Festival. I dressed like this to secretly deliver presents to Syndicans. The disguise and window-climbing are all part of creating a surprise and maintaining the ceremonial atmosphere. I'm not supposed to reveal my true identity.

steps.speaker: Sibilla
steps.content: So you're a thief?

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: Hell no!!! Everything here is practically bargain-bin! I was just passing through. I wasn't going to take anything!

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: And who are you? You're not a Syndican. This counts as trespassing, which is illegal. Leave now, and I won't report you.
Sibilla doesn't answer. Her gaze locks onto the intruder, unblinking.

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: ...Ma'am, do you understand Disian? Excuse me? Hello? Wait... could you be a lost Outlander?

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: It's okay if you don't understand. Do you know how to get back to your group? I can't take you there myself, but I can point you in the right direction. The Cristallia isn't far from here.

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: Par Isabeau Celestine Fait is pleased to meet you. No need to remember me, and please don't come back.

steps.speaker: Sibilla
steps.content: I understand what you're saying, and I know who you are.
Sibilla steps forward. What was extreme terror moments ago now hardens into a wild, desperate fire—the audacity of a soul betting its last coin on fate.

steps.speaker: Sibilla
steps.content: Do me a favor, or I'll shout and let everyone know you're here, Parfait Medici!

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: Argh, come on...!
How could she forget such a fundamental rule? Once suspicion takes root, building credibility becomes nearly impossible. Now, she has no choice but to change tactics...

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: Wait wait wait, let's talk! Now that you know who I am, why not negotiate? That's right, I am Parfait Medici. I'll give you a masterclass in candlestick charts. What do you say? Results guaranteed, and you'll make serious money!

steps.speaker: Sibilla
steps.content: I don't want money. I need you to do me a favor!

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: What is it? Oh, I see now—you want to stay in DisCity, right? Planning to use the Great Expo visit to sneak away from your delegation, hide here in Syndicate, and have a fresh start as a DisCitizen? I can help but—

steps.speaker: Sibilla
steps.content: I can't get into the Great Expo, and I don't want to become a DisCitizen. I only need you to do one thing for me.
Sibilla steps forward and grabs Parfait by both arms.

steps.speaker: Sibilla
steps.content: Deliver a message for me, Parfait Medici. That's all I want.
Flustered, she shoves a crumpled scrap of fabric into Parfait's hand.

steps.speaker: Sibilla
steps.content: You don't need to know what's inside, and do not peek at it. I'm not asking for anything more. Once you've delivered it, I'll go and never trouble you again, I promise.

steps.speaker: Sibilla
steps.content: But if you reveal my secret, peek inside, or tell anyone about me being here—especially those people from Fraser—I'll expose your secret immediately! I'll start screaming right now! Let everyone know that the stock market guru Parfait is here!

steps.speaker: Sibilla
steps.content: I'm so sorry for doing this to you, but I have no choice. Once you hand it over, I'll disappear immediately—I'd even be ready to die here. Please!
Her bony fingers claw into Parfait's arms with desperate strength. The Outlander's sunken eyes stare back—hollow, fever-bright—as if clinging to their last shred of hope.

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: Whoa, calm down! Nothing has even happened yet.
Parfait firmly grips both of Sibilla's arms, steadying the trembling Outlander. She studies her for a moment, then speaks slowly.

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: Nothing has even happened yet. I won't do anything that scares you. Think about it. You already know my biggest secret, and that terrifies me. Why would I risk making you upset?

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: Don't worry, you can trust me. After all, the most reliable people in this world are the ones whose weaknesses you know, don't you agree?

steps.speaker: Sibilla
steps.content: Is... is that so...

steps.speaker: Sibilla
steps.content: ...I don't know, but... I have no choice but to trust you now. Please...
As Sibilla's breathing steadies, Parfait exhales in relief—there, that's better. They can just talk everything through.

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: Yes, trust me, and let's talk this through properly. Who do you want me to find?

steps.speaker: Sibilla
steps.content: A public official, but... I can't get near him. He seems to be someone quite high up. When something happens, he's immediately surrounded by people.
steps.female_content: A public official, but... I can't get near her. She seems to be someone quite high up. When something happens, she's immediately surrounded by people.

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: Hmm... If he's high-ranking, I actually might have a chance to reach him. You say you can't get close... Have you seen him recently? Where was it?
steps.female_content: Hmm... If she's high-ranking, I actually might have a chance to reach her. You say you can't get close... Have you seen her recently? Where was it?

steps.speaker: Sibilla
steps.content: The Great Expo...

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: A high-ranking official at the Great Expo—that would be among the Chamber of Commerce, the Speaker of the City Council, or the Nirvana representatives. I can definitely reach these people. Just leave it to me.

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: What does he look like? Any specific details you can share?
steps.female_content: What does she look like? Any specific details you can share?

steps.speaker: Sibilla
steps.content: His position... I can't remember. The report had his code name, SHP-13.
steps.female_content: Her position... I can't remember. The report had her code name, SHP-13.

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: Do you know his name?

steps.speaker: Sibilla
steps.content: Name... I think it's ${PlayerName}.
At the sound of the name, Sibilla watches as Parfait contorts into an extremely twisted posture and covers her face with her hands.

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: Argh, oh no...!
Twenty minutes later.

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: My credibility as the stock market guru is everything. I can't afford even a whisper of scandal or any unfitting associations. "Parfait Medici" must remain above suspicion, especially regarding that person—I cannot contact him directly.
steps.female_content: My credibility as the stock market guru is everything. I can't afford even a whisper of scandal or any unfitting associations. "Parfait Medici" must remain above suspicion, especially regarding that person—I cannot contact her directly.

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: So I can only help you with the delivery under conditions where I won't expose myself, won't attract attention, and won't get too involved. I've also got my own deals to handle along the way. This will take some time, so you'll need to be patient.

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: But since I gave you my word, consider it done, and I'll ensure your secret stays locked away as you requested. You're still holding my secret, after all.
Parfait extends her hand with a smile.

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: If these terms suit you, let's shake on it. Now, allow me to reintroduce myself—I'm Parfait, just Parfait without the Medici.

steps.speaker: Sibilla
steps.content: ...I'm Sibilla.
Before Sibilla even realizes it, her hand has already grasped Parfait's. Parfait answers with a radiant smile, then turns away to begin making arrangements.

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: I need to act quickly, but before that, we need to sort out your situation.

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: You're also one of my little secrets now, which means we'll have to hide you away somewhere safer. And when I'm not around, we need to have someone protect you.

Parfait juggles various communication terminals all at once, her keystrokes a rapid-fire symphony that electrifies the cramped space. Sibilla watches, dumbfounded, until at last, Parfait leans back with a heavy exhale—the triumphant sigh of a mission accomplished.

steps.speaker: Sibilla
steps.content: ...That ${PlayerName}... I can tell he's a good person from how he treats Jas... I mean, my friend. But you seem afraid of him. Why?
steps.female_content: ...That ${PlayerName}... I can tell she's a good person from how she treats Jas... I mean, my friend. But you seem afraid of her. Why?

steps.speaker: Sibilla
steps.content: Did he also invest in stocks with you?
steps.female_content: Did she also invest in stocks with you?

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: I can't say anything more about that. You have your secrets, and I have mine. This is the stock market guru's deepest one.

Parfait extends her hand with practiced ease. Sibilla, catching on this time, mirrors the gesture. But before their palms can meet, a thunderous bang shatters the silence, rattling the door in its frame.
Just as Parfait moves to answer it, the flimsy lock gives way with a few shakes, and a swarm of people bursts into her tiny, run-down apartment.

The moment the lock snaps, the intruders freeze as one. At their head stands a red-haired woman who, despite awkwardly fingering her worn brass knuckles, maintains every bit of her intimidating presence.

steps.speaker: Gracelyn
steps.content: Parfait, you big dumb***! They caught you? Are they onto you? Hurry, I've got a car ready. Let's get you out of here and to a safe spot!

steps.speaker: Harry
steps.content: Shh, shh! Quiet, quiet!! It's supposed to be a secret!

steps.speaker: Gracelyn
steps.content: The secret's already blown, for ****'s sake! I told her to cut it out, said she couldn't keep it under wraps—but did she listen? Hell no! She's been faking money! Faking MONEY!! I told her not to—
As they shout and burst through the door, the four of them come face to face, and Sibilla distinctly hears a groan of despair.

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: <size=25>...Oh well...</size>
